name: Ingest + proxies
description: One button, three steps: imports a footage folder (Import footage), renders proxies for everything in its bins (Proxies), then attaches them. Asks for the footage folder, then straight away for the proxy folder. Each step is checked before the next starts.

prompts.title: Choose the footage folder to import
Choose where the proxies should go

actions.label: Cancel
actions.confirm: Cancel the proxy renders? Running ffmpeg/REDline jobs are killed; partial files stay on disk. Attach will not run.
